description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Woodfall Primus.
When Woodfall Primus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Woodfall Primus enters, it triggers, destroying a noncreature permanent.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Woodfall Primus.
When Woodfall Primus dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Woodfall Primus enters, it triggers, destroying a noncreature permanent.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
